findings: Carrier verifyModel uses inconsistent normalization: Pwrong scores are FFT/k_fft, Pgood scores are raw cosine sums.
After dividing Pgood by k_fft=3, min aligned Pgood ≈2223 still exceeds Pwrong last-positive T=1802; fraction_inside remains 0.
H-MLKEM-011 survives scale correction; the T-gap shrinks from ~4866 to ~421 but stays strictly positive.
Fig 4.1 x-axis (to ~1600) matches the Pwrong (FFT/k_fft) scale; operating Pgood≈1/2 on that scale is median_raw/k_fft≈3988, still outside the measured Pwrong CDF.
